brief:
Hundreds of demonstrators gathered in central Paris on Saturday for a solidarity rally with Palestine, according to Shehab Wire. Participants carried placards and chanted slogans calling on the French government to impose economic and diplomatic sanctions against Israel in response to its military operations in Gaza and the West Bank.

The rally reflects growing international pressure on Western governments to take stronger positions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Organizers emphasized demands for accountability, with speakers addressing the crowd on allegations of violations against Palestinian civilians. The demonstration occurred as debate continues in European capitals over how to respond to the escalating situation in the occupied territories.
